# Templates

Two GitHub template repos let you ship your own x402 services on day one.

| Template | What you build |
|---|---|
| [`x402-app-template`](/templates/x402-app-template) | An x402-gated MCP service (FastAPI + FastMCP, GCP Cloud Run, Terraform) |
| [`x402-plugin-template`](/templates/x402-plugin-template) | A Claude Code or OpenClaw plugin that consumes one |

Both are MIT-licensed and used in production by Mangrove products themselves — MangroveTrader was built from `x402-app-template`, mangrove-trader-plugins from `x402-plugin-template`.

## Why use them

x402 has a non-trivial integration surface — handling the `402 → sign → retry` round-trip, settling on-chain, validating payment headers, splitting access tiers cleanly, deploying to Cloud Run with proper IAM. The templates encode the patterns Mangrove uses internally so you don't repeat the work.
